name: gen102
same: Value-span question for identical native rho.
different: All teacher parameters were frozen and utility was imitated. Joint task learning was not run.
conclusion: Its STOP remains; no rank/ridge/teacher/seed rescue and no general joint-learning impossibility.

name: same-state value D
same: Exactly v_rt=Tr(V_r rho_t); original Born/EPS weighted mean.
different: A future joint-training protocol changes optimization, not this component formula.
conclusion: Do not present the existing first/second density-moment identity as new theory.

name: QSANN v2
same: Common-state bounded observable values, quantum attention and task optimization.
different: Projected-Gaussian token self-attention with Pauli value channels/residual layers, rather than native Born class routing.
conclusion: Direct component precedent; neither full equivalence nor novelty clearance.

name: Q-BAM
different: Sequential signed disturbance/back-action; D reads preprojection expectation.
conclusion: Structurally different old family remains stopped; no instrument-family revival.

name: gen97/gen92
different: Independent h-linear value channels; covariance or frozen-value warmup, not same-rho expectation.
conclusion: Distinct formulas, but shared-state coadaptation alone is still a generic untested hypothesis.

name: conditional token POVM
same: Can exactly express existing normalized weights and signed pooling.
different: It does not force free utilities to be a Hermitian functional of rho.
conclusion: Reexpression is not a new intervention; tomography bounds do not transfer.
